newsitem.title: CANADA: DBRS upgrades Alliance Forest sr debt.
newsitem.headline: DBRS upgrades Alliance Forest sr debt.

text.p: Dominion Bond Ratings Service said on Tuesday it is upgrading the senior debt rating on Alliance Forest Products Inc to BBB (low), with a stable trend.
Alliance's rating was placed under review with developing implications on December 19, 1996. It was previously rated at BB(high), DBRS said.
The upgrade follows Alliance's acquisition of the Coosa Pines forestry assets from Kimberly-Clark Corp for about C$837 million.
DBRS said the acquisition was funded with C$552 million from an equity issue and the remainder from bank debt.

Although debt levels have increased, they remain resonable at less than 30 percent of capitalization, DBRS said. It said Alliance's equity base also has more than doubled to about C$908 million, further strengthening the balance sheet.
The Coosa Pines assets include a groundwood paper mill, pulp mill, sawmill and associated timberlands, primarily located in Alabama.
DBRS said the acquisition substantially adds to the company's existing Quebec-based groundwood paper operations, while also providing geographic diversification into the U.S.
Although earnings will remain cyclical, Alliance has attained sufficient size and operating diversity to improve its credit quality, DBRS said.
